commands.command: git fetch -q origin main && git reset --hard origin/main && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "984e55baad1e1f6a319b28c2fab2d0309d4918cd" && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo PHASE0_BASE_PASS sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
commands.output:
HEAD is now at 984e55ba Merge completed quality refactor and documentation cleanup
PHASE0_BASE_PASS sha=984e55baad1e1f6a319b28c2fab2d0309d4918cd

commands.command: set -o pipefail; if command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1; then PC=pre-commit; elif [ -x .venv/bin/pre-commit ]; then PC=.venv/bin/pre-commit; else PC='python3 -m pre_commit'; fi; set +e; $PC run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure; rc=$?; set -e; echo PRECOMMIT_RC=$rc; echo PRECOMMIT_STATUS_BEGIN; git status --short; echo PRECOMMIT_STATUS_END; echo PRECOMMIT_DIFF_BEGIN; git diff --; echo PRECOMMIT_DIFF_END; exit 0
